title: Place reuse block schematic sheet
params.cbbSchematicPage: Reuse block schematic sheet. `libraryUuid` is the UUID of the library where the CBB project is located, `cbbUuid` is the UUID of the CBB project, and `uuid` is the UUID of the schematic sheet in the CBB project
params.props: Placement parameters: `reimportWhenNameRepeated` - whether to re-import when a module with the same name exists, default `true`. ADD since EDA v4.2
returns: Place whether the operation is successful
